about: Round RPG16: random events (claude/SPEC_RPG16_DAYNIGHT_2026-10-23.md 3.5, the spec lane's draft, unchanged). Every word, weight and cooldown is a placeholder for Karl to edit (Q3, Q7).

stuck_cart.title: On the road
pages: A carter's wagon sits in the ditch, one wheel sunk to the hub. He waves both arms at you.
You push, he pulls. The wheel comes free with a noise like a boot leaving a bog.
He presses coins on you and won't take them back. It took the best part of an hour.
He shouts something about scribes. It isn't kind.

the_wisp.title: Over the bog
pages: A pale light bobs over the bog, low and slow, as if it wants to be followed.
It leads you a long, wet way round and goes out over a drowned purse. Somebody's loss.
Your boots are full of fen, and the night is older than it was.
You stay where you are. The light waits a while, then goes out.

chapel_bell.title: A bell
pages: Across the moor, the ruined chapel's bell rings once. The chapel has no rope.
Somewhere near the graves, a spade is dropped and a man swears.

well_offering.title: By the well
pages: A card lies face down on the well's edge, under a pebble. Beside it burns a stub of candle.
You turn it over. A good card, and an old one. The candle gutters out as you pocket it.
You leave it lying. Someone left it for someone. It isn't you, tonight.
